responsibility: Defines the core device-independent channel API of the gm2 ISO I/O subsystem. It declares the abstract ChanId type, text and raw read/write operations, common channel management and result-query routines, current flag access, and the standard channel exception family and device error query interface that all concrete device modules and higher-level I/O libraries share.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the device-independent channel contract: it declares the abstract ChanId type, channel operations, read-result accessors, and channel exception types, but not the RTio/IOLink-based dispatch machinery used in IOChan.mod.
